description: This is a charming children's armchair designed to resemble a koala bear. The main body of the chair is upholstered in a light sage green, textured fabric, giving it a soft and inviting appearance. The seat cushion and the inner parts of the rounded ears are a contrasting coral orange color, adding a playful pop. The koala's face features two small black circular eyes and a prominent oval-shaped black nose, all contributing to its endearing character. The chair has a plush, rounded form, suitable for comfortable seating for a young child.
